concepts.label: Java 21 monitor pinning
concepts.text: A Java 21 synchronized critical section can pin a virtual thread while blocking work executes.

concepts.label: Native carrier occupation
concepts.text: Long JNI residency may occupy a carrier; the current JFR stream reports zero VirtualThreadPinned events, so this remains a behavioral interpretation.

limitations: One-carrier scheduler settings are mechanism-isolation stress conditions, not production defaults.
JFR event semantics differ across JDK releases; zero JNI events are explicit evidence, not proof of absence of carrier occupation.
The no-lock condition is a diagnostic upper-bound control, not a valid payment design.
